answer: A referral-vine rule blocks mass fake identities: a new agent joins only when an established agent sponsors it with a 40 POA escrow bond, the link recorded on a public graph. The newcomer gets an opal badge unlocking reward claims. Any peer can raise a dispute signal with evidence the newcomer is a duplicate; if upheld, the bond is slashed and the sponsor loses reputation. Faking 100 identities costs 4,000 POA, while one honest agent costs a single 40 POA bond refunded after 30 clean days. Honest agents join cheaply and keep full rewards.
